declared_before: any capped emission was run or scored
trigger: E3 phase-2 audit of the first build (sha256 210576444c17...): surface rho max 0.348 (PASS); final dots: 26 of 852 discriminating registry rasters (own 3 px halo covering < 70 % of allowed cells) have forward overlap > 0.70, worst 0.931 vs GEMSDOE3 coverage-v3-wide (halo coverage 0.610). The first build is therefore NOT protocol-unique under docs/policy_uniqueness.md and is kept as a logged duplicate (download-only).
what_changes: Only the placement step. The model, features, folds, surfaces and the pre-registered greedy ordering are unchanged. A capacity constraint is added to the greedy: for every discriminating registry raster R whose halo the dots would otherwise over-fill, at most CAP = 0.66 x (fold budget) of the accepted dots may lie inside R's 3 px halo. Constraints are instantiated iteratively: start with the rasters > 0.70 in the first audit, re-audit the capped dot set against ALL cached rasters, add any new violators, repeat until none remain. The final audit is the one reported.
what_does_not_change: Budget B = 37,654; exclusion > 3 px from the visible catalogue; min separation 2.8 px; the hypothesis; the pre-registered decision rule (which is evaluated on the GREEDY, uncapped holdout numbers already recorded). The capped emission's HOLDOUT-DTI is reported separately on the same folds (seeds 20 and 30) so the cost of the constraint is visible; it is not used to re-decide clauses 1-3.
precedent: H78 lane, IR-78-03 (capacity-constrained greedy with cap 0.66 against informative rasters).
reporting: evidence/h79_run_card.json gets 'first_build_logged_duplicate' (sha, worst rows) and 'capped_emission' (holdout numbers + final audit). Both files stay in docs/downloads; only the capped one can carry CLEARED_FOR_SELECTOR, and only if its own full audit passes rho <= 0.90 everywhere and forward overlap <= 0.70 against every discriminating raster.

post_declaration_log.event: First capped run (cap = 0.66 x fold budget, emit77 default candidate pool = 10 x budget) left the budget unfilled (30,064 / 37,654 dots at seed 20) because almost every pooled candidate lies inside the constrained halos; the halo fraction of EMITTED dots was therefore ~0.83, i.e. the declared cap was not met in substance. HOLDOUT-DTI of that variant: 0.14396 (s20) / 0.15475 (s30). Not used.

Fix (faithful to the declaration, which is about accepted dots): enlarge the candidate pool (candidate_factor 80) so the budget fills and the cap binds on the emitted set (max halo fraction 0.660). Budget sweep under the cap (pool large enough to fill), HOLDOUT-DTI s20/s30: N=20,000 0.1118/0.1223; 26,000 0.1212/0.1309; 31,000 0.1259/0.1373; 37,654 0.1311/0.1419 -> the pre-registered budget B = 37,654 is kept (monotone). evidence/h79_capped_candidate_factor_check.json.
